name: Contract S-Class Inquisition
body:
As a contract inquisitor, you have been hired by the church of another deity to track and deal with heretics as well as other creatures that may challenge your contractor’s faith.

Divine Bargain (Ex)

By signing yourself to a contract, you are given a specific requirement, such as execute enemies of the church. As long as you continue to meet the interpretation of your contract’s expectations, you gain the 1st-level power granted by the deity whose church hired you. This doesn’t require you to, for example, kill every possible enemy of the church you encounter on meeting them; you can still keep your own safety in mind. But you must find good reason to keep a contracted target alive, such as using them to find a target more in need of your judgment.

This inquisition requires you to find and make divine bargains. When you finish one contract, or are removed from it by the church who hired you, you lose any related powers until you find a new contract.

Beginning at 8th level, you can hold two contracts at one time, gaining the 1st-level power from each, or you can double-down on your current contract, gaining its second domain power instead for the duration of your contract.

Charm of Wisdom (Ex)

You use your Wisdom modifier instead of your Charisma modifier when making Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks.

Swaying Word (Sp)

At 8th level, once per day you may speak a word of divinely inspired wisdom that causes a single creature to switch its alliance to you. The target must be within line of sight and able to hear you. If he fails his Will save, he is affected by dominate person, except the duration is only 1 minute.
